title: Photo Booth Hire Oxford | Boothdrop Entertainment
metaDescription: Photo booth hire in Oxford for college balls, weddings, graduations and corporate events. Attendant, props and prints included. Get a free quote today.
intro: Oxford events come with their own rhythm: college balls that run until dawn, graduation lunches squeezed between ceremonies, and corporate evenings out at the science parks on the ring road. Our team brings the booth, the attendant, the props and the prints, and deals with the tricky access the city is known for. Packages start from £299 with delivery and setup included.

sections.heading: Getting a booth through a college gate
paragraphs: Oxford's historic venues are beautiful and awkward in equal measure. A typical college job starts at the porters' lodge, where the porter will want the name of the event organiser and the vehicle registration before anyone is waved through. Entrances are often narrow, gated and shared with pedestrians, so a slim pod that one person can wheel through an archway is a real advantage over anything bulky.

Listed-building rules apply almost everywhere in the city centre. That means no fixings to walls, no tape on stone floors and no cables run where they could damage panelling. Lifts are rare in older buildings, so if your reception is on a first floor, let us know and we will plan for a booth that can be carried up a staircase. Beyond the colleges, Oxford has hotel function rooms, town-hall style civic venues, community centres in Headington and Marston, and lively bar and restaurant spaces along Cowley Road.

sections.heading: Access, parking and setup in the city
paragraphs: Park and ride is great for guests but no use to a vehicle full of kit, so we plan vehicle access for every Oxford booking. Many central streets sit inside Low Traffic Neighbourhoods or have timed restrictions, which means the window for unloading can be tight. Tell us the venue's preferred delivery slot and we will arrive within it, unload at the nearest permitted point and move the vehicle before starting to build.

Setting up takes roughly 45 to 60 minutes and is never counted as hire time. All we need from the venue is a single standard plug socket within reach of the booth position and a level patch of floor. Hotel car parks on the ring road are usually straightforward; for central venues we often rely on a short-stay loading bay or the college's own service entrance, which the porters can confirm in advance.
list: Vehicle registration sent to the porters' lodge ahead of arrival
Nearest permitted unloading point agreed with the venue
One standard socket within a few metres of the booth
Stair access flagged early so we bring the right booth
No fixings or tape on listed surfaces

sections.heading: Where in and around Oxford we cover
paragraphs: Oxford is the county town of Oxfordshire and sits at the centre of our Oxfordshire coverage. Within the city we regularly set up in Headington, Cowley, Summertown, Jericho, Botley, Iffley and Marston, and we are just as happy heading out to Kidlington to the north or Abingdon to the south. Venues further afield in the county, from Witney and Bicester to Didcot and Henley-on-Thames, are covered on our main Oxfordshire page.

Delivery, setup and pack-down are included in every package. Oxford is well within our regular patch, so there is nothing extra to pay for travel; if a far-flung rural venue ever did attract a small travel contribution, it would be itemised on the quote before you commit, not added afterwards.

sections.heading: Booths that work well for Oxford events
paragraphs: Students and academics are a sociable crowd, and the Magic Mirror is the booth most often requested for balls and formal dinners. It photographs well in grand rooms, invites guests to sign the screen and prints a copy for everyone in the shot. Where space is at a premium, the LCD SlimPod is the obvious choice: it needs only 1.5 metres by 2 metres of floor and fits through the narrowest lodge.

For launches and networking events at the business parks, the GIF Booth is popular because it is digital-only, creating boomerangs and stills that land in guests' inboxes within seconds and carry the brand overlay with them. The Retro Pod, with its inbuilt printer and classic strip prints, suits graduation parties where parents want something to keep.

sections.heading: Balls, graduations and campus corporate events
paragraphs: Oxford's calendar has clear peaks. Commemoration and summer balls book up months in advance and run late, so plan your hire window around the busiest hours rather than the whole night; unlimited sessions mean guests can come back as often as they like within that time. Graduation parties tend to be daytime or early evening, often in a hotel or a hired hall, where a print booth gives families a tangible souvenir.

Corporate work in Oxford clusters around the science and business parks on the edge of the city, where loading is easy and the brief is usually a branded overlay, a logo on every print and instant social sharing. We can match the print template to your event artwork and supply a custom animated overlay for digital captures too.
list: Student balls: late finish, high throughput, Magic Mirror or Inflatable Booth
Graduation parties: print booth with guest book for the family
College formals: slim pod, no wall fixings, porter-approved access
Science park launches: GIF Booth with branded overlay and QR sharing

sections.heading: Booking an Oxford photo booth
paragraphs: Packages begin at £299 and an £80 deposit secures your date, with the balance due one month before the event. Every booking includes a professional attendant, unlimited sessions during the hire, props, a custom print or overlay template with your text and logo, digital copies with email sharing, LED lighting and public liability insurance, which most Oxford venues will ask to see. Green screen is available on request, and we are rated 5 stars on Trustpilot.

faqs.q: Where do you park and unload at an Oxford college?
faqs.a: We arrange a timed delivery slot through the porters' lodge, send the vehicle registration in advance and unload at the point the college specifies, usually a service gate or courtyard. The vehicle is moved as soon as the kit is inside. For hotels and venues on the ring road we simply use the car park.

faqs.q: Can you set up in an upstairs room without a lift?
faqs.a: Yes. Many Oxford rooms are reached by stairs, so tell us at booking and we will bring one of the slim pods, which two people can carry comfortably. The Magic Mirror and Inflatable Booth are heavier and better suited to ground-floor rooms or venues with a goods lift.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee for Oxford?
faqs.a: No. Delivery, setup and pack-down are included in every package and Oxford is well inside our normal area. If any travel contribution ever applied to a far-flung venue, it would be shown clearly on the quote before you pay a deposit.

faqs.q: Do you work inside Low Traffic Neighbourhoods and timed access zones?
faqs.a: We do. Our attendant plans the route and arrival time around the venue's permitted delivery window, unloads at the nearest legal point and moves the vehicle immediately. Let us know the venue's rules when you book and we will fit around them.

faqs.q: How late can the booth run at a college ball?
faqs.a: As late as the ball committee needs, within the hire window agreed on the quote. Many balls run past midnight, so we suggest timing the hire for the busiest hours after dinner and early in the entertainment, when the queue is longest and the photos are liveliest.
